\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.22}}{}&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.02}}{}&$\mathpre{\pip}$&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.45}}{$\mathpre{\mathid{y},~\mathid{y}_{\mathid{r}}~{\leftarrow}~\textsf{new}~\textsf{stack}~\mathid{x}_{\mathid{p}}~\mathid{l}~(\many{\mathid{x}})}$}&(meta)stack creation (with region and prompt)\\
\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.22}}{}&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.02}}{}&$\mathpre{\pip}$&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.45}}{$\mathpre{\textsf{push}~\textsf{stack}~\mathid{x}}$}&pushing a stack\\
\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.22}}{}&\multicolumn{3}{l}{\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.02}}{\emph{data, codata:}}}&\\
\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.22}}{}&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.02}}{}&$\mathpre{\pip}$&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.45}}{$\mathpre{\mathid{y}~{\leftarrow}~\textsf{construct}~\mathid{C}~(\many{\mathid{x}})}$}&data type construction\\
\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.22}}{}&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.02}}{}&$\mathpre{\pip}$&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.45}}{$\mathpre{\mathid{y}~{\leftarrow}~\textsf{project}~\mathid{x}~\mathid{C}~\mathid{f}}$}&data type projection\\
\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.22}}{}&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.02}}{}&$\mathpre{\pip}$&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.45}}{$\mathpre{\textsf{match}~\mathid{x}~\{\many{\mathid{C}(\many{\mathid{y}}):~\mathid{l}}\}}$}&data type match\\
\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.22}}{}&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.02}}{}&$\mathpre{\pip}$&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.45}}{$\mathpre{\mathid{y}~{\leftarrow}~\textsf{new}~\mathid{I}~\{\many{\mathid{M}:~\mathid{l}}\}~(\many{\mathid{x}})}$}&codata/object creation\\
\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.22}}{}&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.02}}{}&$\mathpre{\pip}$&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.45}}{$\mathpre{\textsf{invoke}~\mathid{x}~\mathid{M}~(\many{\mathid{x}})}$}&method invokation\\
\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.22}}{}&\multicolumn{3}{l}{\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.02}}{\emph{references:}}}&\\
\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.22}}{}&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.02}}{}&\multicolumn{2}{l}{\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.45}}{\emph{(new stack, see above)}}}&\\
\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.22}}{}&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.02}}{}&$\mathpre{\pip}$&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.45}}{$\mathpre{\mathid{y}~{\leftarrow}~\mathid{allocate}~\mathid{x}_{\mathid{r}}~(\mathid{x})}$}&allocation in region\\
\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.22}}{}&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.02}}{}&$\mathpre{\pip}$&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.45}}{$\mathpre{\mathid{y}~{\leftarrow}~\textsf{load}~\mathid{x}}$}&load from reference\\
\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.22}}{}&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.02}}{}&$\mathpre{\pip}$&\mdinline{width=\dimwidth{0.45}}{$\mathpre{\textsf{store}~\mathid{x}~\mathid{x}}$}&store in reference\\

\section{RPyeffect}\label{sec-rpyeffect}%mdk%mdk-565

%mdk-data-line={270}
\noindent(actual format JSON-based)%mdk-565

%mdk-data-line={272}
Very similar to ASM. Most notable differences: Registers are indices, some restrictions on arguments for jumps etc, register movement in explicit small instructions.%mdk-565
